Claude Reflect monthly recap: see your most active day and topics, and set break reminders. Beta, web and desktop.

Claude Reflect monthly recap: 4 settings that show your AI use. Beta, so not everyone sees it.

1. Recap - Open Settings, then Reflect, to see your month.
2. Stats - See your most active day, peak hour, and conversation count.
3. Topics - See a proportional breakdown of what you discussed.
4. Focus - Settings, then Time and focus: break reminders, quiet hours. Applies on mobile too.

Needs: Beta, Free/Pro/Max
